blocks.text: Team preview of the Toronto Raptors ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 46-36, lost to Cleveland in first round of playoffs. Coach: Darko Rajakovic (4th season, 101-145). Season opener: Oct. 21 vs. Chicago. Departures: F Brandon Ingram, G Gradey Dick, F Sandro Mamukelashvili. Additions: F Kawhi Leonard, F Allen Graves, F Kyle Anderson. What to expect The addition of two-time Finals MVP Kawhi Leonard elevates the Raptors to the upper tier of Eastern Conference contenders, but Toronto will face plenty of competition for the top spot.
